## Experiment Title
What are we testing?

## Objective
What question are we trying to answer?

## Hypothesis
What do we expect to happen, and why?

## Affected System
- [ ] Frame / Structural
- [ ] Bed Docking / Alignment
- [ ] Toolhead / Motion
- [ ] Electronics / Thermal
- [ ] Firmware / Software
- [ ] Other

## Test Configuration
- Project / CAD revision:
- Prototype version:
- Materials:
- Imperial / Metric variant:
- Equipment used:
- Software / Firmware:
- Environmental conditions:

## Test Procedure
Describe the steps performed.

## Measurements
Record measured values, units, instrument
resolution, uncertainty, and relevant conditions.

## Acceptance Criteria
What measurable thresholds define success?
Were these established before testing?

## Test Results
- [ ] PASS
- [ ] FAIL
- [ ] INCONCLUSIVE
- [ ] NOT COMPLETED

## Observations
What happened during the experiment?

## Unexpected Behavior / Failures
Document problems, unexpected results,
and potential root causes.

## Safety Assessment
Identify hazards, safety controls,
and any test-abort conditions.

## Evidence
Attach photographs, measurements,
logs, calculations, or video references.

## Conclusions
What did we learn?

## Next Steps
What should happen next?

---
A test result only applies to the specific
configuration and conditions tested.
Simulation does not replace physical testing.
